scripts.build:wasm: rm -rf pkg && wasm-pack build crates/wasm --scope fedibtc --target bundler --out-dir ../../pkg --no-opt && rm -f pkg/.gitignore && pnpm run format:pkg
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:ts
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && wasm-pack pack --pkg-dir pkg
scripts.publish: pnpm run build && npm publish ./pkg --access public
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm run build && npm publish ./pkg --access public --dry-run
